data.title: Jobcenter invitation on 22 April 2026
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen invites Lea Muster to a meeting on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 about her current work situation. Bring your CV.
data.explanation: This is a mandatory invitation (Meldeaufforderung) from the Jobcenter. Go to room 1.18 to see Ms Petzold on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 and bring your CV (Lebenslauf). If you miss it without an important reason, your Bürgergeld is reduced by 10 percent of the standard rate for one month. If you can't attend, contact the Jobcenter before the date and explain why. The letter names no formal objection route.

items.title: Meeting at Jobcenter with Ms Petzold

items.action: Attend the meeting and bring your CV (Lebenslauf).
items.consequence: Without an important reason, your Bürgergeld is reduced by 10 percent of the standard rate for one month.
